subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the passage in no more than 90 to 100 words.
guide_solution: Bangladesh is a developing country of Asia. Average literacy rate of Bangladesh, India and Pakistan are respectively 56. 8%, 74% and 54.9%. Male and female literacy rate in Bangladesh respectively 61.3% and 522%, in India 82.1% and 5% and in Pakistan 68.6% and 40.3%. Among the three countries the female literacy rate in Pakistan is the lowest.
